If the frame, suspension or exhaust shows "abnormal", the corresponding group loses significant weight and the total maps to a poor condition grade with key risks flagged; if only a few non-load-bearing parts have minor rust, the total still sits at moderate. The report aggregates scores and issues by group for targeted negotiation.
